description: FIND-106 template_version 1.1.0, docs_verified 2026-09-17 (https://developers.openai.com/codex/hooks). WIRE-10: one-shot via `vanta-cli mcp-call` (no pwsh). Copy to <repo>/.codex/hooks.json (or ~/.codex/hooks.json); review via /hooks. DB: replace <DB_PATH>; vanta-cli must be on PATH. Secrets: session env only. Hook input arrives on stdin as JSON; {{prompt}} splices the verbatim prompt text (mcp-call resolves it, jq not needed).

hooks.command: echo VantaDB save-state: persist open turns via thread_send and/or scene_write before compaction.
echo VantaDB auto-capture: persist this turn via thread_send role+content; proxy-turns curated via inbox, never auto-promote.
